parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A circular rubber wheel attached to the lower side of the trashcan for mobility.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the trashcan to be easily moved or tilted for transportation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axle to enable rolling motion.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A second rubber wheel located opposite the first one, providing balance and mobility.
parts.Functional_description: It works in conjunction with the first wheel to stabilize and move the trashcan smoothly.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle, synchronized with the other wheel for balanced rolling.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A hinged plastic lid that covers the top opening of the trashcan.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents odors from escaping and keeps debris or rainwater from entering the bin.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around a hinge, allowing it to open and close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main container structure of the trashcan, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and contains waste materials, providing structural support for the lid and wheels.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can tilt when the trashcan is moved.
